name: 33412 · West Palm Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33412 (West Palm Bch) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33412 (West Palm Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33412 (West Palm Bch) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
